question: In June 2025, who has become the first woman ADC (Aide-de-Camp) to the President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yashasvi Solanki**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yashasvi Solanki** has become the **first woman Aide-de-Camp (ADC)** to the President of India in **June 2025**.
 
• An **Aide-de-Camp (ADC)** is a personal assistant or aide to a senior military officer or head of state and serves as a prestigious designation.
 
• Her appointment marks a significant milestone in the **Indian Armed Forces**, as it demonstrates the growing representation of women in leadership and high-ranking positions.
 
• As an ADC to the President, her responsibilities include assisting the President in official ceremonies, functions, and day-to-day activities, along with liaising with military and civilian agencies.
 
• Her achievement is a testament to the **Indian Armed Forces' evolving inclusivity** and commitment to recognizing talent irrespective of gender.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Aide-de-Camp (ADC) Role:**

 
 
• An ADC is a military officer who acts as a confidential assistant to a senior officer or dignitary, such as the President of India.
 
• They are generally selected from the **Indian Armed Forces**, including the Army, Navy, and Air Force, based on their exemplary service record and leadership skills.
 
• ADCs play a pivotal role in coordinating schedules, organizing events, and maintaining decorum during official functions.
 
 
 
• **Women in Armed Forces:**
 
 
• The appointment of women in higher and distinguished roles highlights **gender inclusivity** in the Indian Armed Forces.
 
• In recent years, several steps have been taken to **empower women** in the military, such as offering permanent commissions and leadership roles.
 
• Notable achievements include women being inducted as fighter pilots, commanding units, and now serving as ADCs to the President.
 
 
 
• **President's Secretariat:**
 
 
• The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Armed Forces, and the ADC serves as a direct link between the President and the military.
 
• The ADC accompanies the President during official engagements, both within India and abroad.
 
 
 
• **Other Options in the Question:**
 
 
• **Neena Gupta:** Known as a celebrated actress in Indian cinema, she is not associated with the military or the ADC role.
 
• **Aliawati Longkumer:** While a notable name, there is no record of her serving as an ADC to the President.
 
• **Anuradha Thakur:** A senior bureaucrat, but not linked to the military or ADC appointments.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of ADC Appointment:**

 
 
• The ADC role is a recognition of excellence and discipline in the armed forces.
 
• This position is highly prestigious and allows the officer to act as a direct representative of the President in military matters.
 
 
 
• **Milestones in Women Empowerment:**
 
 
• The appointment of women in roles such as ADC reflects the government's efforts towards **inclusivity** and **gender equality**.
 
• It also inspires future generations of women to pursue challenging and prestigious careers in the military.
